known_issues: The module keeps a module-level reference to the celestial portal and listens for a 'remove' event that the game never fires, so a removed portal is never forgotten; the suite therefore runs the no-portal case first. This is upstream behaviour, not part of the task.

Every run generates a new world. The checks that look for dropped items (the combined helm's turf, the dial without a portal and the celestial portal's glass) are placed at the nearest offset from the spawn portal where all ground within the search radius is land, because items flung onto an ocean tile sink.

The base-game save of a partly mined Glommer statue is written by hand as `{ workable = { maxwork = -1, workleft = 2 } }`, which is what the base game's Workable:OnSave returns for a statue the module never touched.
The Glommer statue checks run one second after the statues are spawned, so a fix that defers setting the full work by a frame (as upstream does) is seen after it has run.
